findings.note: Steichen confirmed Jones will start (Oct 26), but RotoWire warns that more poor games could lead the 2-5 Colts to try Anthony Richardson, so a mid-game benching could cut Jones's attempts.
Jones's recent attempts were 22 (last week's 16-10 loss to MIN), 42, 44, 34 and 36, so his last game fell well short of 31.5; Jacksonville's defense ranks 3rd in points allowed (17.3).
Covers picks Jaguars -9.5 (total 46.5) and expects a comfortable JAX win, which points to the Colts trailing and passing more, though it rates Jones's efficiency among the league's worst.
